observations: Two photos show a large blue plastic drum with a hinged lid and two white caps on top.
The drum has visible scratches, scuffs, and green paint marks on the surface.
The lid has three metal hinges and two white caps, one of which is open.
The drum is placed on a dirt ground, surrounded by other similar drums and jerrycans.
No brand or model markings are visible on the drum in either photo.
The seller's watermark 'SAIVET NIGERIA ENTERPRISE' is overlaid on both images.
The drum appears to be used and possibly stored outdoors.

claims.evidence: No visual evidence of quality beyond appearance; no proof of material, condition, or performance.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drum may be damaged or compromised internally, such as cracks, leaks, or contamination.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the drum's interior, or a video showing the drum being filled and emptied.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially compromised or unusable

risks.risk: The drum may not be food-grade or may have been used for non-food purposes.
risks.proof: A clear shot of any labels, markings, or certification stickers on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-food-grade or unknown use

risks.risk: The drum may have been previously used for hazardous or corrosive substances, posing safety risks.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the drum being cleaned or inspected for residue.

proof_requests: Close-up of any labels, markings, or certification stickers on the drum.
Video or photo showing the drum being filled and emptied to check for leaks or damage.
Close-up of the interior of the drum to check for cracks or residue.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
